text:
I am tired.

I look at

this city

-any city-

where for twenty years I have lived.


Everything is the same.

A child

uselessly counts the stars

on the neighboring balcony.


I start as well...

But he goes faster: I cannot

catch up with him:

One, two, three, four,

five...


I cannot

catch up with him: One, two...

three...

four...

five...

translation.title: The Star Counters
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the counting rhythm and the speaker's quiet inability to keep pace.
